title: Python sender mistakes inbound ACK-REQ for outbound negative ACK
description: SchcSessionManager.record_verified_frame accepts ACK-REQ bytes 0x7800/0x7880 through Ack.from_bytes as C=0 ACKs. With simultaneous bidirectional T=0 transfers on the same Rule 0x78, Node sender-control dispatch consumes the peer's inbound-session ACK-REQ before reassembly, advances sender high-water, then drops on bitmap validation; the inbound session never receives its response. Classify ACK-REQ direction before generic ACK parsing and route it only to reassembly. Add simultaneous bidirectional same-rule/window tests including abort/ACK/ACK-REQ ambiguity.
